questions.title: 喜欢的城市自然之地
questions.text:
Describe a natural place in your city that you enjoy visiting
You should say:
Where it is
What it is like
How often you go there
Who you often go there with
And explain why you enjoy visiting there
questions.english:
A natural place I'd like to describe is a small public park near the apartment where I live in Guangdong. It has trees, a walking path and a few benches, so it's somewhere I can go without making a big plan.

I usually visit it once or twice a week, often on my own and sometimes with my mother. We live together, so a short walk is an easy way to spend time together. I don't go there for a serious workout; the main purpose is to take a break.

What I enjoy is the change of atmosphere. I spend a lot of time around computers and enjoy programming, so being somewhere with trees and fewer screens would help me slow down. I could walk at my own pace and let my thoughts settle.

The park wouldn't need to be famous or especially large. For me, an accessible green space is valuable because I could use it regularly. I'd like it because it offers a simple, comfortable break from indoor study.
questions.chinese:
我想描述的自然场所，是广东住所附近的一座小公园。公园有树木、步道和几张长椅，因此不用特别计划就能去。

我通常每周去一两次，经常独自去，有时与母亲一起去。我们同住，所以短途散步是一起相处的方便方式。我不会把去公园当成正式锻炼，主要目的是休息。

我喜欢的是环境的变化。我经常接触电脑，也喜欢编程，因此去一个有树木、较少屏幕的地方，可以让自己慢下来。我能按自己的节奏行走，让思绪平静。

这座公园不必出名，也不必特别大。对我而言，方便到达的绿地很有价值，因为可以经常使用。我会喜欢它，因为它能提供一种简单、舒适的方式，暂时从室内学习中休息。
pending: 公园是否存在、访问频率、同行者和感受均为候选；广东公寓与同住母亲已确认

questions.title: 攒钱买特别物品
questions.text:
Describe a time when you saved money to buy something special
You should say:
What the special thing was
Why you wanted to buy it
How you saved money for it
And explain how you felt after buying it
questions.english:
Something special I saved money for was a better computer. Last year, I wanted to buy one while studying AI because I enjoyed programming and wanted my coding work to run more smoothly.

I didn't buy the first model I saw. I compared a few options and tried to work out which features I actually needed. A computer can be expensive, so I wanted to spend the money on something useful rather than simply choosing the newest one.

To save for it, I put aside a little money regularly and reduced a few optional purchases. I also kept a simple record of how much I'd saved. That made the goal feel more manageable than thinking about the total price all the time.

After buying it, I felt pleased because it was connected with both my studies and my interests. I would use it for programming, reading and other everyday activities. The satisfaction wasn't just about owning a new device. It came from planning the purchase carefully and finally getting something that would serve a clear purpose.
questions.chinese:
我曾为之攒钱的一件特别物品，是一台更好的电脑。去年，我在学习人工智能时想买电脑，因为喜欢编程，也想让编程工作更顺畅。

我没有买第一眼看到的型号，而是比较几个选择，弄清楚真正需要哪些功能。电脑可能很贵，因此我希望把钱花在有用的东西上，而不只是选择最新款。

为了攒钱，我定期留出一点钱，减少一些可有可无的购买，也简单记录已经存了多少。相比一直想着总价，这样会让目标更容易实现。

买到后，我很高兴，因为它与专业和爱好都有联系。我会用它编程、阅读和完成日常活动。满足感不只是来自拥有新设备，也来自认真规划购买，最终得到一个有明确用途的东西。

questions.title: 喜欢的城市自然之地
questions.text: Which is more important, protecting the environment or developing the economy?
questions.english: I don't think a country can safely ignore either one. Economic development provides jobs and funds for public services, while environmental protection supports health and long-term living conditions. The better question is how to develop without causing unnecessary damage. Cleaner transport and energy-saving production are examples of investment that can serve both goals at the same time.

questions.text: Is it easier to spend money or save money?
questions.english: Spending is usually easier because buying something gives an immediate reward. Saving asks people to delay that reward and resist tempting offers. Online shopping can make spending almost effortless. Still, saving becomes more manageable with a realistic budget and an automatic transfer. That way, people don't have to make the same difficult choice every time they receive money.

questions.text: Should parents teach their children to spend money freely or to save money?
questions.english: Parents should teach children to balance spending and saving rather than encourage either extreme. questions.text: Should schools teach children how to manage money from a young age?
